iterative.why: 7 is at index 3. For 4 the range shrinks until lo passes hi, and the method returns -1.

loop-condition.why: With inclusive bounds, lo == hi is still one candidate to check. lo < hi would skip it.

lower-bound.why: mid satisfies the condition, but an earlier index might too. Keep it as the best answer so far and look left for a smaller one.

on-the-answer.why: If a capacity works, every larger one does too: a monotone condition, so binary search on the answer applies. Trying every capacity is correct but slow, and reordering packages isn't allowed.

answer-cost.why: About log₂ S candidates are checked, each costing O(n).

needs-order.why: It needs a monotone condition (for arrays: sorted order) to know which half to throw away. On unsorted data it can discard the half that holds the value.
